description: Template for timestamps.json file used in EMG comparative analysis
note: Times are in seconds. Each gesture/object can have multiple trials.

usage_notes.how_to_use: Copy this template to your data directory and update the timestamps
usage_notes.key_format: Gesture IDs must be strings ('0', '1', etc.)
usage_notes.time_format: Times in seconds from start of recording
usage_notes.multiple_trials: You can have any number of trials per gesture (must match in starts/ends)
